title: Loop run event line
$comment: One line of .loop-run/events.jsonl, written by packs/core/.apm/skills/work-loop/scripts/loop-engine.py on every FSM transition. The contract this pins is owned by docs/specs/loop-telemetry-export/spec.md; docs/architecture/telemetry.md section 5.1 describes the envelope. `schema` is absent on records written before it shipped, so it is optional here and constrained only when present -- a replayed legacy record is appended unchanged and must still validate.

seq.description: Transition sequence within the run; joins to the cohort on <run_id>:<seq>.

run_id.description: Identifies the run, not the agent and not the spec.

at.description: RFC 3339 instant the transition was written.

schema.description: Envelope version. Absent on records written before versioning shipped; never retro-stamped onto a replayed record.

phase_started_at.description: When the phase being left began. Null when it could not be worked out -- never omitted.

phase_s.description: Seconds in the phase being left.

result.description: What a gate decided. Null for the five routing events that decide nothing; a consumer counting passes and failures must filter that out first.

awaiting_input.description: True exactly when the destination is one of the three human-gate states.

waived.description: True when the caller supplied --allow-retry-cap-override on this transition. It does not mean a cap was reached.

budgets.description: A copy of the cohort retry counters as they stood one transition ago; loop-cohort owns them and moves them afterwards.
